source_text: What did you do then?

text: Well, I was a trader.  Did pretty good making a circuit between survivors.  Lost a lotta good people, though. [Coughs]

source_text: How?

text: Gangers got'em.  Scavengers attacking the caravans.  And mutants, son of a dog, if they weren't springing up like rabbits with a mission. [cough] Had to have an army of guards with, just to do a deal.

source_text: Course they helped, ya bonehead!  Just too damn many to handle!

text: How did you survive the mutant attacks?

text: Didn't.  Got killed. [Laughing cough] Love that joke.

text: Uh, yeah.
source_text: Uh, yeah.

text: Everywhere!  Hell, seemed like you couldn't fart without hitting one.  But mostly in the northwest.

text: You farted northwest?

source_text: Richard Grey?

text: Where exactly did you go?

text: Needed to see what was there.  Maybe stop whatever was churnin them boogers out.  We thought we were prepared.  Were we wrong.

text: Robots and such.  Lot of'em.  Damn surprised they was still running after all this time, what with the war and all.  Whooa boy they tore us a good one.
source_text: Robots and such.  Lot of'em.  Damn surprised they was still running after all this time, what with the war and all.  Whooa boy they tore us a good one.
